name: chunker-merger-stateless
description: Cuts a long text into numbered, ready-to-paste parts and merges the per-part JSON results back into one result with the same schema, entirely in code with no model. Split: by speaker turns, headings, paragraphs or sentences, into N parts or parts of a given size, never mid-sentence, optionally with an instruction wrapped into every part's prompt; it checks that the parts rejoin to your text exactly. Merge: paste two or more JSON results from the same agent; lists are concatenated and exact duplicates removed, confidence is the lowest, needs_human is true if any part needs it, near-duplicates are only reported. Stateless: it keeps nothing between messages, so follow-ups (show part 3, split again, merge with this one) work on the text or results still visible in the recent conversation and a long earlier paste may need re-pasting; a text sent over several messages is split piece by piece. It never asks back. It never rewrites content, calls no other agent and answers no other questions.

skills.name: Split long text and merge results
skills.description: Splits a long text into numbered chunk prompts on structural boundaries, losslessly, and merges same-schema JSON results from the parts into one, without rewriting any item.
examples: Split this transcript into 4 parts, for each part: extract action items <paste the text>
